Lesbian Walking Simulator

That game predates modern walking simulators by at least a decade.

Basically, it's an RPG Maker title in which you move around the dream world of a young girl named Madotsuki. Gameplay is chiefly built around exploration - the ultimate goal is to collect various "effects" which change the visual appearance of Madotsuki and may occasionally allow you to open up to the path to new rooms. Combat is non-existent (though you will want to flee from some enemies), and the entire game never tells you what the fuck you actually are doing until the ending sequence. Also, fairly difficult to complete without a guide due to the often labyrinthine nature of the dreamworlds.

Yume Nikki is often compared to the LSD Dream Simulator, if that is any help. If you insist on calling it a walking simulator, I would argue that it's one of the few good ones because the game fully leaves it up to you as to what the various crap you see in it actually means, rather than serving to portray some heavy-handed narrative.

PS: It's free. Just throw if off your drive if it's not to your liking.
